SOFTWARE DEVELOPER | Airsme Technology Pvt Ltd | LINK	January 25- Present Technologies: Angular, RxJS, NgRx, Socket.io, Bootstrap, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, RESTful APIs

Developed and maintained Admin, Buyer, Professional, and Partner web applications for both mobile and web platforms using Angular. Implemented state management using NgRx with actions, reducers, and selectors for efficient data handling and scalability. Applied lazy loading techniques to optimize the application's performance by reducing initial bundle size.

Utilized RxJS operators such as map(), filter(), switchMap(), and mergeMap() for asynchronous operations and optimized API calls. Integrated Socket.io for real-time communication and implemented live data updates, enhancing the user experience.

Built responsive and mobile-friendly UI components using Bootstrap and custom SCSS for cross-platform compatibility. Added pagination, sorting, and filtering functionalities to efficiently display large datasets and improve data accessibility.

Worked with RESTful APIs to fetch, update, and manage data, ensuring seamless integration with the backend. Handled authentication and authorization using JWT tokens and Angular guards to secure application routes.

Deployed and maintained applications, ensuring continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines were streamlined. Designed and implemented dynamic form validation using Angular Reactive forms & custom Validations.

Personal Portfolio | personalportfolio-madhuri-2052002.netlify.app	March 25- April 2025

Developed a full-stack personal portfolio application using Angular for the frontend and Node.js with Express.js for the backend.

Utilized MongoDB Atlas as the database solution for scalable and secure data storage.

Implemented RESTful APIs for seamless data communication between the frontend and backend.

Deployed the backend on Render and the frontend on Netlify, ensuring continuous deployment and accessibility.

Payment Integration | Ongoing	April 25- Present

Integrated secure payment gateway using Java, Spring Boot, and REST APIs in a microservices-based architecture.

Followed Agile/Scrum methodologies, managed tasks via JIRA, and collaborated using Git and Bitbucket.

Leveraged AWS services for cloud deployment and scalability of payment modules.

CERTIFICATES

Full stack development- Java (Exceler)	may-septemper 2024

Completed Full Stack Web Development course focused on Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and MySQL.

Gained hands-on experience building end-to-end web applications with frontend to backend integration and CRUD operations.

Experienced ui Developer skilled in Angular, JavaScript, typescript, html,css and bootstrap with expertise in building dynamic web applicatios.
